_doc: Per-chip pin rules shared by the node builder (web) and ul_board (firmware). 'unusable' pins are errors, 'caution' pins are warnings. Limits are hard errors. A reset button on boot_button is fine. The C3 column is from Espressif docs and should be checked against real C3 boards.

caution.2: strapping pin, must not be pulled low at boot
caution.8: strapping pin, must be high at boot (often the dev-board LED)
caution.18: USB D-, lost for flashing and logs over USB
caution.19: USB D+, lost for flashing and logs over USB

unusable.14: not brought out on the WROOM module

caution.12: USB D-, lost for flashing and logs over USB
caution.13: USB D+, lost for flashing and logs over USB
